changes.subject: build: add pre-commit gate (ruff, bandit, markdownlint, yamllint, gitleaks)

excluded.reason: model: not relevant to this change

findings.quote: Modules under `src/adrcheck/domain/` import only the standard library and each other.
findings.reason: The domain import changes from typing.Callable to collections.abc.Callable, both standard library, so the domain still imports nothing outside the stdlib.

findings.line_text: offenders = [(p.name, mod) for p in DOMAIN.glob("*.py") for mod in imports_of(p) if mod.startswith(FORBIDDEN)]
findings.quote: The boundary is enforced by `tests/test_boundaries.py`, which fails on the first offending import.
findings.reason: The offenders comprehension is only collapsed onto one line, with the same filter, so the boundary test still flags forbidden imports.

findings.quote: No code path reports a CONFLICT that skipped `verify()`.
findings.reason: The verify() call in _settle is only reformatted across lines with the same Claim arguments, so verification still runs before a verdict stands.

findings.line_text: Finding(adr.number, None, Verdict.UNCLEAR, signals, note=f"judge error: {response.error}")
findings.quote: A judge that errors, times out or returns unparseable output yields an UNCLEAR finding whose reason begins `judge error`
findings.reason: The judge-error branch is reformatted only and still yields an UNCLEAR finding with a note beginning `judge error`.

findings.quote: `CachedCompiler` stores the result under a key derived from the ADR's content hash and `PROMPT_VERSION`, and returns the cached obligations on every later run until either changes.
findings.reason: The cache key material is only rewrapped and still combines prompt_version with the ADR content, so the key derivation is unchanged.

findings.quote: A waived ADR is reported as COMPLIANT with the reason shown, so the waiver is visible in the report, never silent.
findings.reason: The waived finding is only reformatted and still reports COMPLIANT with the waiver reason in its note.

findings.line_text: change, lambda needle, parent=change.parent: repo.contains(parent, needle) if parent else None
findings.quote: The `RepoReader.contains()` probe answers those questions against the parent ref.
findings.reason: The lambda still probes repo.contains at the parent ref; binding parent as a default argument only fixes the lambda's late-binding capture of the variable.
